info.name: A Proper Reward for a Good Deed

descriptions.notStarted: I got bamboozled by a Red Scorpion, thinking I was helping Sand Bandits out. Good thing I noticed it before it went on for too long, and I stole some from their treasures and gave them out to others. I feel great about it, but for some reason, #bSirin#k wanted to talk to me about it.
descriptions.inProgress: Sirin told me I have done more good deeds that made up for helping out the Red Scorpions, and that she said it's okay for me to look for some #bcompensation#k from this. Compensation? Who's going to pay me?
descriptions.completed: As a small compensation for all that, I took some from the treasure chest. This should be enough.
